actions.label: Cancel a command
actions.caption: Type viewer, then esc clears the command; esc again closes the empty palette. Cancel an unfinished command without changing the document.

actions.label: Close with Ctrl+C
actions.caption: Type viewer, then ctrl+c closes the palette. It cancels this command line without quitting o-json.

actions.label: Complete a command name
actions.caption: Type viewer vie, then tab completes view. Completion saves typing and shows which verbs are available.

actions.label: Move back through commands
actions.caption: Type viewer and move down twice; ctrl+p returns to the previous match. Use it to refine the command choice.

actions.label: Choose a command
actions.caption: Type viewer and a space, then ctrl+n highlights the first matching command. Read the command name before running it.

actions.label: Open the command palette
actions.caption: esc closes the current palette; ctrl+space opens a fresh one. Use this alternative to : when reaching for named commands.

actions.label: Return to an empty command line
actions.caption: Run viewer view, reopen, and recall it with up; down returns to the empty command line so you can type something new.

actions.label: Recall a command
actions.caption: Run viewer view once, reopen the palette, then up recalls it. Reuse a command without typing it again.

actions.label: Run a named command
actions.caption: Type viewer view, then enter runs it. The data view changes just as it does with its bound key.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
